en.text: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 心中的谋算在乎人； 舌头的应对由于耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 心中的謀算在乎人； 舌頭的應對由於耶和華。

en.text: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the motives.

zhSimplified.text: 人一切所行的，在自己眼中看为清洁； 惟有耶和华衡量人心。

zhTraditional.text: 人一切所行的，在自己眼中看為清潔； 惟有耶和華衡量人心。

en.text: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.

zhSimplified.text: 你所做的，要交托耶和华， 你所谋的，就必成立。

zhTraditional.text: 你所做的，要交託耶和華， 你所謀的，就必成立。

en.text: The LORD has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华所造的，各适其用； 就是恶人也为祸患的日子所造。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華所造的，各適其用； 就是惡人也為禍患的日子所造。

en.text: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; they shall certainly not be unpunished.

zhSimplified.text: 凡心里骄傲的，为耶和华所憎恶； 虽然连手，他必不免受罚。

zhTraditional.text: 凡心裏驕傲的，為耶和華所憎惡； 雖然連手，他必不免受罰。

en.text: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.

zhSimplified.text: 因怜悯诚实，罪孽得赎； 敬畏耶和华的，远离恶事。

zhTraditional.text: 因憐憫誠實，罪孽得贖； 敬畏耶和華的，遠離惡事。

en.text: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

zhSimplified.text: 人所行的，若蒙耶和华喜悦， 耶和华也使他的仇敌与他和好。

zhTraditional.text: 人所行的，若蒙耶和華喜悅， 耶和華也使他的仇敵與他和好。

en.text: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.

zhSimplified.text: 多有财利，行事不义， 不如少有财利，行事公义。

zhTraditional.text: 多有財利，行事不義， 不如少有財利，行事公義。

en.text: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.

zhSimplified.text: 人心筹算自己的道路； 惟耶和华指引他的脚步。

zhTraditional.text: 人心籌算自己的道路； 惟耶和華指引他的腳步。

en.text: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 王的嘴中有神语， 审判之时，他的口必不差错。

zhTraditional.text: 王的嘴中有神語， 審判之時，他的口必不差錯。

en.text: Honest balances and scales are the LORD’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.

zhSimplified.text: 公道的天平和秤都属耶和华； 囊中一切法码都为他所定。

zhTraditional.text: 公道的天平和秤都屬耶和華； 囊中一切法碼都為他所定。

en.text: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.

zhSimplified.text: 作恶，为王所憎恶， 因国位是靠公义坚立。

zhTraditional.text: 作惡，為王所憎惡， 因國位是靠公義堅立。

en.text: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.

zhSimplified.text: 公义的嘴为王所喜悦； 说正直话的，为王所喜爱。

zhTraditional.text: 公義的嘴為王所喜悅； 說正直話的，為王所喜愛。

en.text: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.

zhSimplified.text: 王的震怒如杀人的使者； 但智慧人能止息王怒。

zhTraditional.text: 王的震怒如殺人的使者； 但智慧人能止息王怒。

en.text: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.

zhSimplified.text: 王的脸光使人有生命； 王的恩典好像春云时雨。

zhTraditional.text: 王的臉光使人有生命； 王的恩典好像春雲時雨。

en.text: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

zhSimplified.text: 得智慧胜似得金子； 选聪明强如选银子。

zhTraditional.text: 得智慧勝似得金子； 選聰明強如選銀子。

en.text: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

zhSimplified.text: 正直人的道是远离恶事； 谨守己路的，是保全性命。

zhTraditional.text: 正直人的道是遠離惡事； 謹守己路的，是保全性命。

en.text: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

zhSimplified.text: 骄傲在败坏以先； 狂心在跌倒之前。

zhTraditional.text: 驕傲在敗壞以先； 狂心在跌倒之前。

en.text: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.

zhSimplified.text: 心里谦卑与穷乏人来往， 强如将掳物与骄傲人同分。

zhTraditional.text: 心裏謙卑與窮乏人來往， 強如將擄物與驕傲人同分。

en.text: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed.

zhSimplified.text: 谨守训言的，必得好处； 倚靠耶和华的，便为有福。

zhTraditional.text: 謹守訓言的，必得好處； 倚靠耶和華的，便為有福。

en.text: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

zhSimplified.text: 心中有智慧，必称为通达人； 嘴中的甜言，加增人的学问。

zhTraditional.text: 心中有智慧，必稱為通達人； 嘴中的甜言，加增人的學問。

en.text: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.

zhSimplified.text: 人有智慧就有生命的泉源； 愚昧人必被愚昧惩治。

zhTraditional.text: 人有智慧就有生命的泉源； 愚昧人必被愚昧懲治。

en.text: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.

zhSimplified.text: 智慧人的心教训他的口， 又使他的嘴增长学问。

zhTraditional.text: 智慧人的心教訓他的口， 又使他的嘴增長學問。

en.text: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

zhSimplified.text: 良言如同蜂房， 使心觉甘甜，使骨得医治。

zhTraditional.text: 良言如同蜂房， 使心覺甘甜，使骨得醫治。

en.text: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

zhSimplified.text: 有一条路，人以为正， 至终成为死亡之路。

zhTraditional.text: 有一條路，人以為正， 至終成為死亡之路。

en.text: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.

zhSimplified.text: 劳力人的胃口使他劳力， 因为他的口腹催逼他。

zhTraditional.text: 勞力人的胃口使他勞力， 因為他的口腹催逼他。

en.text: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.

zhSimplified.text: 匪徒图谋奸恶， 嘴上仿佛有烧焦的火。

zhTraditional.text: 匪徒圖謀奸惡， 嘴上彷彿有燒焦的火。

en.text: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.

zhSimplified.text: 乖僻人播散纷争； 传舌的，离间密友。

zhTraditional.text: 乖僻人播散紛爭； 傳舌的，離間密友。

en.text: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.

zhSimplified.text: 强暴人诱惑邻舍， 领他走不善之道。

zhTraditional.text: 強暴人誘惑鄰舍， 領他走不善之道。

en.text: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

zhSimplified.text: 眼目紧合的，图谋乖僻； 嘴唇紧闭的，成就邪恶。

zhTraditional.text: 眼目緊合的，圖謀乖僻； 嘴唇緊閉的，成就邪惡。

en.text: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

zhSimplified.text: 白发是荣耀的冠冕， 在公义的道上必能得着。

zhTraditional.text: 白髮是榮耀的冠冕， 在公義的道上必能得着。

en.text: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

zhSimplified.text: 不轻易发怒的，胜过勇士； 治服己心的，强如取城。

zhTraditional.text: 不輕易發怒的，勝過勇士； 治服己心的，強如取城。

en.text: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 签放在怀里， 定事由耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 籤放在懷裏， 定事由耶和華。
